title: Stage — HTTP y API
description: Flujo HTTP, endpoints, clientes, contenedores y logs de stage.

panels.title: Estado API
panels.description: Sonda externa cada 30 s a /health a través de Cloudflare.

panels.title: % 4xx
panels.description: 401/403/404: normalmente tokens vencidos, permisos o escáneres.

panels.title: Latencia p95
panels.description: Tiempo total en nginx (incluye API). Excluye el stream SSE.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | path!~"/source-events/stream.*" | unwrap request_time [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: Uptime contenedor
panels.description: Tiempo desde el último (re)inicio del contenedor.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (rate({job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto]))
quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | path!~"/source-events/stream.*" | unwrap request_time [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | path!~"/source-events/stream.*" | unwrap request_time [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.99, {job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | path!~"/source-events/stream.*" | unwrap request_time [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Requests por tipo de cliente
panels.description: Según User-Agent: Dart = app móvil (notifier), Mozilla = navegador.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | label_format client=`{{ if hasPrefix "Dart" .ua }}app móvil{{ else if contains "Mozilla" .ua }}navegador{{ else }}otro{{ end }}` [$__auto]))

topk(20, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+(/|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}" .path "/:id") "/:uuid") "/:n${1}" }}` [$__range])))

topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json | path!~"/source-events/stream.*" | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+(/|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}" .path "/:id") "/:uuid") "/:n${1}" }}` | unwrap request_time [$__range]) by (method, route))

sum by (method, route, status) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", env="stage", status=~"5.."} | json | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+(/|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}" .path "/:id") "/:uuid") "/:n${1}" }}` [$__range]))

topk(20, sum by (method, route, status) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", env="stage", status=~"4.."} | json | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+(/|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}" .path "/:id") "/:uuid") "/:n${1}" }}` [$__range])))
topk(20, sum by (remote_addr, country) (count_over_time({job="nginx_access", env="stage"} | json [$__range])))
